name: Moguro Hagane
description: Moguro Hagane is the former Eighth ranking Divine General of the Sacred Vollachia Empire, known as the 'Steelman'. A living meteor integrated into the Crystal Palace of the Imperial Capital Lupugana, Moguro can transform into a colossal iron golem to protect the throne, playing an antagonistic role in Arc 7 before aiding the Empire during Arc 8.
